title: Publication-grade audit of the profiled Ds population bridge
statement: DS11-DS14 were independently re-derived and survived exact-rational exhaustive attack (1,748 admissible moves at all 171 stable states of five adversarial datasets including vector nuisance and vector POI; 400 variational-identity instances with singular blocks; both fixtures re-verified; fully exact N=10 global-optimum margin scan). DS11's core identity is classical (Krein/Anderson/Li-Mathias: prior art found); DS12/DS13 verified with hardened assumptions (selection-independent deployability; merged atoms dropped, degenerate destinations closed via Fischer); DS14 verified as a conditional theorem after supplying the fixed-class slab Glivenko-Cantelli step, the derived Lambda, the compact parameter set, and the general-d_psi merged-value argument. Targeted search for DS12-DS14 found no direct equivalent: a search gap, not novelty.
